title_zh: 莫言：获得诺贝尔文学奖的中国作家
title_en: Famous Chinese People (8/20): Mo Yan, China's Nobel Prize-Winning Novelist
note_en: 一边……一边…… (yìbiān… yìbiān…) links two actions done at the same time: 后来一边工作一边坚持写作 "later kept on writing while working." English uses "while" or "-ing" for one of the actions, but Chinese repeats 一边 before each verb, giving both equal weight. Both actions need the same subject, so you can't use it for two different people.
